# fl_place_autocomplete

> Google Places autocomplete for Flutter on Android, iOS and web, built on the Places API (New) with session tokens handled for you. Provides a headless Dart API (`FlPlaceAutocomplete`) and a customizable pure-Dart text field (`PlaceAutocompleteField`). Federated plugin; depend only on `fl_place_autocomplete`.

Key facts for code generation:
- Add `fl_place_autocomplete: ^0.1.0` to pubspec.yaml. Import `package:fl_place_autocomplete/fl_place_autocomplete.dart` (it re-exports the models; never import the platform packages directly).
- Requires Flutter 3.47+. Android minSdk 23. iOS 16+ and Swift Package Manager only (`flutter config --enable-swift-package-manager`); there is no CocoaPods support.
- API key is passed at build time: `--dart-define=GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY=KEY`, or per platform `GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY_ANDROID` / `_IOS` / `_WEB` (these win), or `--dart-define-from-file=env.json`. Fallbacks: Android manifest meta-data `com.google.android.geo.API_KEY`, iOS Info.plist `GMSPlacesAPIKey`, web Maps JS already loaded in index.html. Do not hard-code keys in Dart source.
- Enable "Places API (New)" in Google Cloud (plus "Maps JavaScript API" for web). Restrict each key to its platform.
- Sessions: `newSession()` -> `findPredictions(..., session:)` repeatedly -> `fetchPlace(..., session:)` once, which ends the session. A session is single-use; reusing an ended one throws `PlaceAutocompleteException` with code `sessionEnded`. Call `cancelSession` to abandon one. `PlaceAutocompleteField` manages sessions itself.
- `fetchPlace` requires a non-empty `fields` set (`Set<PlaceField>`); only requested fields are billed/returned.
- Errors are `PlaceAutocompleteException` with `code` (`PlaceAutocompleteErrorCode`: invalidApiKey, quotaExceeded, networkError, invalidRequest, notFound, sessionEnded, unknown) and `message`.
- Platform limits: `languageCode` is ignored on Android and iOS; on iOS some `Place` fields (`shortFormattedAddress`, `primaryType`, `primaryTypeDisplayName`, `nationalPhoneNumber`) are always null.
- The widget's default "Powered by Google" footer satisfies attribution; if you replace it via `footerBuilder`, attribution becomes the app developer's responsibility.

## Minimal usage

```dart
import 'package:fl_place_autocomplete/fl_place_autocomplete.dart';

// Widget: returns the full Place on selection.
PlaceAutocompleteField(
  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Search a place'),
  options: PredictionOptions(includedRegionCodes: ['fr']),
  fields: {PlaceField.displayName, PlaceField.location, PlaceField.formattedAddress}, // default
  onPlaceSelected: (place) => print('${place.displayName} at ${place.location}'),
  onError: (e) => print(e),
);

// Headless.
final places = FlPlaceAutocomplete.instance;
final session = places.newSession();
final predictions = await places.findPredictions('eiffel', session: session);
final place = await places.fetchPlace(
  predictions.first.placeId,
  session: session, // concludes the session
  fields: {PlaceField.displayName, PlaceField.location},
);
```

Widget parameters worth knowing: `controller` (`PlaceAutocompleteController`), `debounce` (300 ms), `minChars` (2), `fetchDetailsOnSelect` (true), `onPredictionSelected`, `onPlaceSelected`, `onError`, and builders `fieldBuilder`, `predictionBuilder`, `loadingBuilder`, `emptyBuilder`, `errorBuilder`, `separatorBuilder`, `headerBuilder`, `footerBuilder`. Photos: `FlPlaceAutocomplete.fetchPhoto(PlacePhotoRef, maxWidth:, maxHeight:)` returns `PhotoData`.

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://github.com/kishormainali/fl_place_autocomplete/blob/main/fl_place_autocomplete/CHANGELOG.md)
- Packages: fl_place_autocomplete_platform_interface (models, platform base class), fl_place_autocomplete_android, fl_place_autocomplete_ios, fl_place_autocomplete_web (endorsed implementations, pulled in automatically)
- Status: not yet verified against the live Places API (unit/widget/native tests only)
